details.method: Validate decoded object names as Unicode scalar text before invoking storage, including deletion keys; preserve valid escaped pairs and non-ASCII names.
details.when: A JSON transport accepts object names later encoded into canonical UTF8 content identities.
details.counterexample: JSON syntax acceptance does not ensure every escaped string can be UTF8 encoded; valid surrogate pairs decode into a normal scalar and must remain accepted.
details.trial_plan: In a future adoption, send lone high/low surrogates and mixed-batch deletes through real transport; assert422, zero storage calls and unchanged database, then roundtrip Chinese and emoji names.
